graders.evidence: # UI Audit — Reminders (2026-10-27) ## Stack - Framework: Vanilla JS + FastAPI serving one Jinja template (single-page app with client-side tabs) - Build tool: none (raw HTML/CSS/JS served from `app/static/`) - CSS: plain CSS in `app/static/styles.css` plus inline `style=` attributes in `app/templates/index.html` - State: none — data lives in the DOM; reminders are re-fetched after each change - Design tokens: `app/static/styles.css` (`:root` with `--color-primary`, `--color-success`, `--color-text`, `--space-2`) ## Pages / Routes (top 10) - `/` — `app/templates/index.html` (the single page, rendered by `app/main.py`) - Tab "Today" — `#today` view, filled by `loadReminders()` in `app/static/app.js` (shows reminders not yet done) - Tab "All reminders" — `#all` view, `app/static/app.js` (shows every reminder; done ones are struck through) - Tab "Settings" — `#settings` view, `app/templates/index.html` (notification time input + Save) - `GET /api/reminders` — `app/main.py` - `POST /api/reminders/{reminder_id}/done` — `app/main.py` ## Style approach There is a small stylesheet that defines four design tokens, but nothing uses them: `var(--` appears 0 times. The colours are typed in directly instead, 16 different ones across 2 files, and 11 inline `style=` attributes in the template override the stylesheet. Each tab button has its own grey (`#333`, `#444`, `#555`), and the "Done" button uses a different blue (`#3182ce`) from the header (`#2b6cb0`). ## Pain points ### 🔴 High - **Not usable on phones.** There is no ``, the page is fixed at `width: 800px` (`index.html:7`), views at `760px` (`styles.css:9`), the input at `300px`, and there are 0 media queries. On a phone the page shows as a tiny zoomed-out desktop page. - **Design tokens exist but are never used.** The `:root` tokens in `styles.css` are ignored, and colours are hardcoded in both files instead. Pointing everything at the tokens is the cheapest way to get a consistent look, and it lets a redesign change colours in one place. - **No loading, error or empty states.** `loadReminders()` and `markDone()` (`app.js:9-29`) show nothing while waiting, never check `res.ok`, and the "Done" button can be clicked many times. An empty list shows a blank area: the `.empty` class is defined but never used. - **Settings "Save" does nothing real.** It only shows an `alert()` (`app.js:31-33`). graders.evidence:
# UI Audit — Reminders (2026-10-27) ## Stack - Framework: Vanilla JS + FastAPI serving one Jinja template (`app/templates/index.html`) - Build tool: none (raw static files mounted at `/static`) - CSS: plain CSS in `app/static/styles.css` (13 lines) plus 11 inline `style=` attributes in the template - State: none. The DOM is the state. `loadReminders()` re-renders by rebuilding `innerHTML`, and `markDone` is a global called from inline `onclick` - Design tokens: `app/static/styles.css` (`:root` holds 4 tokens), but none of them are used (0 `var(--` references) ## Pages / Routes (top 10) This is a single-page app. The three tabs are what users see as "pages". - `/` → tab **Today**: `app/templates/index.html` (`#today`), filled by `app/static/app.js`. Shows reminders that aren't done yet - `/` → tab **All reminders**: `app/templates/index.html` (`#all`), filled by `app/static/app.js`. Shows every reminder - `/` → tab **Settings**: `app/templates/index.html` (`#settings`). One "Notification time" input and a Save button - `GET /api/reminders`: `app/main.py`. Returns the in-memory list - `POST /api/reminders/{id}/done`: `app/main.py`. Marks a reminder as done File sizes: every file is under 50 lines, so none needs splitting. ## Style approach Most styling is written inline in the HTML. That includes the page width, the header colour, the three tab text colours and the Save button colour. The small stylesheet covers tabs and reminder rows with hardcoded hex values. There is a `:root` token block whose values match colours used elsewhere, but nothing references it, so the tokens and the actual styles have already drifted apart. ## Pain points ### 🔴 High - **Not usable on phones.** There is no ``, the `` is fixed at `width: 800px`, `.view` at `760px` and the input at `300px`, and there are 0 media queries. On a phone the page shows zoomed out and scrolls sideways. - **Design tokens exist but nothing uses them.** `--color-primary` (#2b6cb0) and `--color-success` (#38a169) are typed out again as inline hex values instead of being referenced. There are 16 unique colours in a 2-file UI, and the three tab buttons each have a different grey (#333, #444, #555). Wiring everything to tokens is the highest-value redesign step. - **No loading, error or empty states.** Both `fetch` calls were checked. `loadReminders()` shows a blank area while loading and does nothing if the request fails. `markDone()` doesn't disable its button, so double clicks send repeat requests. The `.empty` style is defined but never used, so an empty "Today" tab is just blank. - **Broken and inaccessible logo.** `` has no `alt`, and `logo.png` isn't in `app/static/`, so the header shows a broken-image icon. ### 🟡 Medium - **No semantic structure or ARIA.** There are 0 `aria-` attributes, no `
